'''Sparks''' is a male [[wolf]].

== Appearance ==
He has a dark brown pelt.

== Activities ==
Sparks is one of the wolves [[Perrin Aybara]] meets in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' and joins him on his hunt of the white stag.
Sparks is present when [[Hopper]] continues to teach Perrin how to hunt in the wolf dream.
Sparks is one of the wolves who Hopper uses to ''shift'' to other places and then get Perrin to track through scent. Perrin's pack is caught inside the [[dreamspike]] and hunted down by [[Slayer]]. Sparks is hit in the thigh with an arrow from Slayer and is rescued by Perrin before he is killed.
Perrin returns to the wolf dream and attacks Slayer with the aid of the wolf pack. [[Oak Dancer]] is stabbed and killed during the encounter and Sparks is again severely injured. He crawls away and finds the dreamspike. Perrin grabs it and ''shifts'' away with it. He tells the wolves to move off in different directions to confuse Slayer.

== Trivia ==
* Sparks is named for Andrew Sparks, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
